Container.Name: MeshSense
Container.Overview:
Monitors, maps and graphs your area's Meshtastic network -- connected nodes, signal reports, trace routes and more -- from a web UI, by connecting to one of your Meshtastic nodes over WiFi/TCP. This is a headless build of Affirmatech's MeshSense (built daily from upstream source); Bluetooth and USB serial are not supported in the container. Set ADDRESS to your node's IP, or enter it in the UI after first boot.
Beta: upstream is in beta and this image tracks upstream master.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent MeshSense state (settings, last connection, logs), stored in a meshsense subfolder. Mounted as a folder, not a file mapping.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: MeshSense web UI and API. If you change the host port only, the WebUI link follows it; to change the port MeshSense itself listens on, set PORT below and this mapping together.

Config.Name: ADDRESS
Config.Description: IP address or hostname of your Meshtastic node (WiFi/TCP). When set, MeshSense connects on startup. Leave blank to enter it in the UI.

Config.Name: ACCESS_KEY
Config.Description: Optional access key (sent as a Bearer token) that grants full API permissions to remote clients. Note upstream already treats IPv4 clients (::ffff: addresses) as trusted, so this is not a login for the web UI -- keep the port off the internet.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port MeshSense listens on inside the container. Change together with the WebUI port mapping.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The container starts as root, chowns /config to this id and drops to it before running MeshSense -- match whoever owns the path above (Unraid's default user is 99).
